findings.passage: “Coloradans should be able to cast their ballots without fear or intimidation. Deploying armed guards at postal facilities just as voting begins demands an explanation and urgent action,” said Congresswoman Brittany Pettersen.
findings.note: Press release in her name about her letter to the Postal Inspection Service on armed guards at postal facilities where voters may drop off mail ballots. Related to mail-voting access, not to ID or citizenship rules. The memo it describes has guards checking IDs of people at postal sites, not voters.
subjects: mail voting access and voter intimidation
